decision_record: B64 is an independent business of ai-revenue-lab, not a PADIEM Chat/Apps product (issue #987 owner decision 2026-10-27). The CONTROL_PLANE_IDENTITY and PADIEM_CHAT_SERVICE bindings introduced by #5954 leave the target set: B64 authenticates its own members from its own D1. PADIEM_SESSION_SECRET never enters it. B64_SESSION_SECRET is owner-minted and is reported by the deploy gate rather than declared here, because wrangler.jsonc cannot declare a secret value.
